cd /work && python3 -c "
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np, math
im=np.array(Image.open('observations/obs_0104.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
R,G,B=im[:,:,0],im[:,:,1],im[:,:,2]
fl=(abs(R-G)<25)&(R>120)&(R<190)&(G>110)&(B>90)&(B<165)&(R-B>15)
def fit(lo,hi):
    P=[]
    for u in range(lo,hi):
        c=np.nonzero(fl[:,u])[0]
        if not len(c) or c.min()<=258: continue
        v=int(c.min()); D=396.8/(v-256.); L=D*(u-256)/256.
        P.append([L,D])
    if len(P)<6: return None
    P=np.array(P); c=P.mean(0); A=P-c
    _,_,V=np.linalg.svd(A); d=V[0]; n=np.array([-d[1],d[0]])
    return abs(n@c), np.abs(A@n).std(), len(P), math.degrees(math.atan2(d[0],d[1]))
print('NORTH-wall band u100..330 :',fit(100,331))
print('RIGHT band       u400..511:',fit(400,512))
print('LEFT  band       u0..40   :',fit(0,41))
# per-column detail on right edge
for u in range(380,512,12):
    c=np.nonzero(fl[:,u])[0]
    if not len(c): continue
    v=int(c.min()); D=396.8/(v-256.); print('  u%3d v%3d D=%.2f L=%.2f'%(u,v,D,D*(u-256)/256.))
" 2>/dev/null
